subject: Computação
description_pt: Utilizar diferentes navegadores e ferramentas de busca para pesquisar e acessar informações.

components.description_pt: Usar navegador web para acessar informações na internet
components.description_en: Use a web browser to access information on the internet

components.description_pt: Usar ferramentas de busca para localizar informações específicas em ambientes digitais
components.description_en: Use search tools to locate specific information in digital environments
components.cc_component_description: Locate relevant scientific information using text features such as headings, glossaries, and tables of contents

components.description_pt: Comparar resultados de diferentes ferramentas de busca ao pesquisar mesmo tópico
components.description_en: Compare results from different search tools when researching the same topic
components.cc_component_description: Compare two arguments on the same topic to identify similarities and differences in the evidence each emphasizes

cc_matches.description: Obtain information using various texts, text features (e.g., headings, tables of contents, glossaries, electronic menus, icons), and other media that will be useful in answering a scientific question and/or supporting a scientific claim.
Compare and critique two arguments on the same topic and analyze whether they emphasize similar or different evidence and/or interpretations of facts.
